Independent educational practice app. Not affiliated with MOE or SEAB. Photographs are AI-generated original practice stimuli, not official examination photographs. Scoring is an approximate writing-support rubric, not an official PSLE mark. Signed-in student marking and progress are saved to your family cloud account. Speech dictation depends on browser support and may use the browser provider’s speech service. A private, trusted device is recommended.
